definitions.explanation: Describes the person or thing one loves most. Often used for close family members or romantic partners, conveying deep emotional attachment.

examples.japanese: {最愛|さいあい}の{妻|つま}に{感謝|かんしゃ}している。
examples.english: I am grateful to my beloved wife.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{最愛|さいあい}の{娘|むすめ}を{病気|びょうき}で{失|うしな}った。
examples.english: He lost his beloved daughter to illness.

examples.japanese: {最愛|さいあい}の{人|ひと}と{過|す}ごす{時間|じかん}ほど{大切|たいせつ}なものはない。
examples.english: There is nothing more precious than time spent with the one you love most.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used as a modifier with の: {最愛|さいあい}の + noun. Carries a literary, emotional tone. Common in written language, speeches, and formal contexts. Less common in casual everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最愛|さいあい}の{人|ひと} (one's most beloved person)
- {最愛|さいあい}の{妻|つま} / {夫|おっと} (beloved wife / husband)
- {最愛|さいあい}の{子|こ} (beloved child)
- {最愛|さいあい}の{家族|かぞく} (beloved family)
